# P36.65 — Onboarding content (manifest row 408, K14 UXK14-11)

Closes `docs/tickets/408_P36.65__onboarding-content.md`. `live_verification=false` — fixture-verified only; no `live:`-leg, no production mutation, no gate flips, no claim-spine write.

## What lands

**Per-page reading keys (K14 §6.3)** — every dossier page carries a "How to read this page" action in the header band that jumps to a native `<details>` key listing **only the symbols the page's own model proves present**: the support glyph (when figures render), the contested marker (a contested figure or the declared/located pair), the unresolved mark (a figure with no winning claim), the absence kinds the page actually uses (from `dossier.gaps` + absence rows), the inferred ◈ marker (L4 rows), and withheld (publication-policy rows). Every label, glyph and one-line meaning comes from `lexicon.json` — the key can never fork the epistemic vocabulary — and every row links the glossary (a term anchor when a dedicated entry exists, the glossary root otherwise). Zero client JS: no tour, no overlay, no storage.

- `web/src/lib/reading-key.ts` — the model (`dossierReadingKey` computes the present set; `glossaryTerm` fails closed on a missing term).
- `web/src/components/ReadingKey.astro` — the `<details>` block, component-scoped styles (no shared-CSS weight added to any route).
- `web/src/pages/dossier/[...path].astro` — the band action + key mount.

**The typed empty vocabulary is complete (K14 §6.4, SIG-UI-086/151)** — `EMPTY_KIND_PARTS` in `web/src/lib/empty.ts` gives the four cause classes that had no dedicated surface canonical five-part copy: `filtered_none` (clear-filters target is the caller's own route — required override, the canonical row can never lie about clearing a filter it cannot see), `not_redistributable`, `degraded`, and `not_monitored` (the watch coverage cause, previously harness/place-parameterized copy only). `emptyCauseCovered` is the coverage predicate — every `EmptyCause` resolves to copy, and a missing kind fails the unit/build check. The component-kit harness now mounts the registry rows instead of inline fixture copy. Hatch semantics preserved: the three non-absence causes never hatch; `not_monitored` does (a real coverage absence).

**The annotated dossier page (K14 §6.3)** — `/about/how-to-read-a-dossier/` (T1 under the existing `/about/**` entry — no registry edit) is generated from the release's golden dossier (`goldenPlace()` — the first joined dossier): a numbered list of static callouts, one per template-plan unit, each linking the live section anchor it describes so the walk regenerates each release and can never drift from the rendered page. It also exhibits the reading key the dossier itself carries. With no joined dossier it names that state (a typed `none_recorded` empty) and annotates the template contract rather than faking a walk. Callouts are conditional on what the dossier renders (e.g. the roll-up block only when children/rollup exist — a callout never links an absent anchor).

## Copy governance

40 new drafted sentences land as `pending` rows in `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-17.md` (sha256-pinned): KY-01…03 (reading-key chrome + withheld line), EK-01…20 (the four kind causes × 5 parts), HD-01…17 (the annotated page; HD-02/07 pin sentence shapes with `{name}`/`{section-bodies}` placeholders, the `{reviewStatus}` precedent). `tests/unit/test_p36_65_copy_batch.py` asserts the batch parses, hashes verify, every row binds, and every `data-copy` id on the new surfaces cites a batch row.

## Verification

- `npm --prefix web run check` — typecheck 0 errors; unit suite incl. `reading-key.test.ts` (per-symbol presence/absence legs over a synthetic dossier + every fixture dossier's glossary terms resolve) and `empty-kind.test.ts` (every `EmptyCause` covered, kind registry = exactly the four unsurfaced causes, `filtered_none` requires the caller's route); build 428 pages, `/about/how-to-read-a-dossier/` classified T1 by the registry sweep; e2e `onboarding-content.spec.ts` (the key lists the golden dossier's real symbols; ≥10 callouts; every callout anchor resolves on the live page); axe WCAG 2.2 AA in the sweep.
- `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_p36_65_copy_batch.py` — 7 passed.
- Root-absolute-paths containment: no growth — the new `path` prop is allow-listed with a reason (the `/about/` precedent), `EMPTY_KIND_PARTS` hrefs ride `withBase`, and the harness's `/component-kit/` clear-filters literal is covered by the existing P36.23 exemption.
